items.raw_excerpt: Nearly 3,000 runners took part in the Puli Power mountain running event in central Taiwan's Nantou County on Sunday, passing through scenic spots including Hutoushan Mountain and Liyu Lake while sampling local specialties at 20 food stations along the route.
items.summary_en: Nearly 3,000 runners joined the Puli Power mountain running event in Nantou County, central Taiwan. They ran past scenic spots like Hutoushan Mountain and Liyu Lake. Along the route, they tasted local specialties at 20 food stations.
items.summary_ko: 대만 중부 난터우현에서 푸리 파워 산악달리기 대회가 열렸고, 3,000명 가까운 러너가 참가했다. 참가자들은 호투산과 리위 호수 같은 아름다운 명소를 지나쳤다. 코스 곳곳의 음식 부스 20곳에서는 지역 특산물도 맛볼 수 있었다.
items.title_en: 3,000 Run in Puli Power Mountain Event
items.title_original: 3,000 take to the hills for Puli Power running event

items.raw_excerpt: Los británicos estrenaron el clip de su sencillo "Mr Charm".
items.summary_en: The Rolling Stones released a new music video for their single "Mr Charm." Swedish actor Alexander Skarsgard appears in the video. The band shared the clip for fans to watch.

items.raw_excerpt: ในเช้าวันที่ 3 ตุลาคม คณะกรรมการประชาชนเขตคัวนาม ร่วมกับกองบังคับการตำรวจป้องกันและดับเพลิง นครฮานอย จัดโครงการเรียนรู้เชิงปฏิบัติการ "พวกเราคือนักดับเพลิง" ณ โรงเรียนมัธยมจุงหว่อง โดยมีนักเรียนในเขตเข้าร่วมกว่า 400 คน
items.summary_en: More than 400 students joined a hands-on program called We Are Firefighters at a secondary school in Hanoi. Local officials and fire police taught them fire prevention, firefighting, and rescue skills. The program helped children know what to do during a fire.
items.summary_ko: 하노이 쿠아남 지역의 한 중학교에서 400명이 넘는 학생이 '우리는 소방관' 체험 프로그램에 참여했다. 지역 인민위원회와 하노이 소방경찰이 화재 예방과 진압, 인명 구조 기술을 직접 가르쳤다. 학생들이 화재 상황에서 스스로를 지키는 법을 익히게 하려는 것이 이번 교육의 목적이었다.
items.title_en: Hanoi Students Learn Firefighting Skills at School
items.title_ko: 하노이 중학생 400여 명, 학교에서 소방 기술 체험

items.raw_excerpt: The picturesque Lac des Brenets between France and Switzerland has dried up after a record-breaking hot summer, leaving locals crying out for help to save the lake.
items.summary_en: The Lac des Brenets on the French-Swiss border has dried up after a record hot summer. Locals are asking for help to save the lake they love.

items.title_en: A shared lake dries up after a hot summer

items.summary_en: The Lac des Brenets on the France-Switzerland border has dried up after a record hot summer. Locals are asking for help to save the lake, which usually draws visitors to both countries.

items.raw_excerpt: Mexico turned Bel Woodhouse into a botanical artist, as evidenced by this illustrated look at Yucatán's natural beauty.
items.summary_en: A writer says living in Mexico turned her into a botanical artist. She now draws the plants and wildflowers she sees in Yucatan. Her illustrations show the natural beauty of the region.
items.summary_ko: 한 작가는 멕시코에서 살아가며 식물 일러스트레이터가 되었다고 말한다. 그녀는 유카탄에서 본 식물과 야생화를 그린다. 그녀의 그림은 이 지역의 아름다운 자연을 보여 준다.
items.title_en: From jungle to wildflowers: How Mexico made me a botanical artist
